# NICEVX — Curated Adult Video Discovery

> NICEVX is a limited adult discovery catalog that publishes verified source records and transparent ranking signals.

## Site
- URL: https://www.nicevx.com
- Language: English
- Audience: Adults 18+
- Authoritative published URL list: https://www.nicevx.com/sitemap.xml

## How it works
- Media is embedded from Eporner; NICEVX does not host the media files.
- Every watch page links visibly to its original Eporner source.
- The NICEVX Discovery Score uses measured snapshots, source rating, category-relative views, freshness, and metadata completeness.
- Trend claims require at least two snapshots and are never invented by AI.
- DeepSeek may clean supplied metadata but may not add unsupported facts.
